title: Clocked machine construction
statement: Given an alphabet embedding that marks emitted symbols, a $k$-work-tape machine $M$, and a Boolean stopping predicate on its states, construct a machine with $k+1$ work tapes and the clock simulation states. Its initial state is the finish state carrying no body state. In a decrement state, if the phase is run and the stopping predicate holds, it enters the finish state carrying the current body state; otherwise it performs the embedded decrement-machine transition and maps its successor state through the decrement-phase exit map. In a body state it performs the embedded transition of $M$ and maps the result to the clock simulation states. In finish and timeout states it stays in the same state without moving heads, writing symbols, or emitting output.
